name: MongoDB Atlas 6
description: The Sumo Logic App for MongoDB Atlas allows you to monitor database operations, performance KPIs and provides visibility into the security posture of your clusters.

children.name: MongoDB Atlas - Overview
children.description: The MongoDB Atlas - Overview dashboard provides a high-level view of server availability, messages, and commands.
children.title: MongoDB Atlas - Overview

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where severity in ("E", "F")
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs alertConfigId
| json "id","updated","metricName","status", "groupId","hostnameAndPort","typeName","replicaSetName","links","clusterName" as id,updated,metricName,status, project_id,hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName,links,cluster_name nodrop
| topk(1, updated) by id
| where status = "OPEN"
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs "Slow query"
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.command.$db","attr.durationMillis" as severity,timestamp,component,context,database,duration
| number(duration)
| where duration > 100
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")
| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users","result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name
| where result!=0
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs "authentication failed"
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx","attr.authenticationDatabase","attr.remote","attr.principalName","attr.error" as timestamp,severity,component,context,database,client_ip,user,reason
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs alertConfigId
| json "id","updated","metricName","status", "groupId","orgId","hostnameAndPort","typeName","replicaSetName","links","clusterName" as id,updated,metricName,status, project_id, org_id, hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName,links,cluster_name nodrop
| topk(1, updated) by id
| if (isNull(org_id), format("https://cloud.mongodb.com/v2/%s#alerts", project_id), format("https://cloud.mongodb.com/v2#/org/%s/alerts/list", org_id)) as link
| tourl(link, id) as id
| count by id, updated,metricName,status, project_id,hostnameAndPort,typeName,replicaSetName
| sort by updated
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and (_source=events OR _source=orgevents)
| json "id", "groupId", "orgId", "eventTypeName", "metricName", "links", "hostname", "port", "created", "username", "remoteAddress" as id, project_id, org_id, eventTypeName, metricName, links, hostname, port,created, username, remoteAddress nodrop
| where eventTypeName matches "*"
| if (isNull(org_id), format("https://cloud.mongodb.com/v2/%s#activity", project_id),format("https://cloud.mongodb.com/v2#/org/%s/activity/list", org_id)) as link
| tourl(link, id) as id
| count by created, id, org_id, project_id, eventTypeName, metricName, hostname, port, username, remoteAddress
| sort by created

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where severity in ("E","F","W") OR msg matches /error*|fail*|exception*|timeout*|stop*|shut*|down*|exit*/
| count by hostname,component,msg,timestamp
| topk(3, timestamp) by hostname, component
| format("Timestamp: %s\nComponent: %s\nMessage: %s", timestamp, component, msg) as latest_error
| fields -msg, component, _count, timestamp
| transpose row hostname column _rank

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| if (severity="I", "Informational", if(severity="W", "Warning", if(severity="E", "Error", if(severity="F", "Fatal", "Debug")))) as severity
| count by severity

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs (NETWORK OR ASIO) (reach OR connect)
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx","attr.error.codeName","attr.error.errmsg" as timestamp,severity,component,context,errorName,errorMessage
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| where (component matches "*NETWORK*" or component matches "*ASIO*") and (errorName matches "*HostUnreachable*")
| hostname as from_node
| parse regex field=errorMessage "(?<dest_node>(?<=server ).*(?=,))" nodrop
| last(msg) by project_id, cluster_name, from_node, dest_node
| if (_last matches "Successfully*", 1, 0) as isreachable
| where isreachable = 0
| _last as message
| fields -isreachable,_last

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs ("dbexit") or  ( "] waiting for connections on port") or ("transition to" or "Transition to") 
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx" as timestamp,severity,component,context
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| if (_raw matches "*dbexit*", "Down",if (_raw matches "*Transition to*", "Up" ,if (_raw matches "*] waiting for connections on port*", "Up", "UnKnown")))  as server_status
| timeslice 100s
| withtime server_status 
| where (server_status = "Up")
| withtime _messagetime
| most_recent(server_status_withtime) as server_status, most_recent(_messagetime_withtime) as m_time by hostname
| formatDate(fromMillis(m_time), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS", "etc/utc") as event_time
| ((toMillis(now())-m_time)/(1000*60)) as since_mins | format("%.2f", since_mins) as since_minutes
| concat ("Since ", since_minutes, " minutes") as Remark
| fields - m_time, since_mins, since_minutes 
| fields hostname, event_time, server_status, remark

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs ("dbexit" or  ( "] waiting for connections on port") or "transition to") 
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx" as timestamp,severity,component,context
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| if (_raw matches "*dbexit*", "Down",if (_raw matches "*Transition to*", "Up" ,if (_raw matches "*] waiting for connections on port*", "Up", "UnKnown")))  as server_status
| timeslice 100s
| withtime server_status 
| where (server_status = "UnKnown") 
| withtime _messagetime
| most_recent(server_status_withtime) as server_status, most_recent(_messagetime_withtime) as m_time by hostname
| formatDate(fromMillis(m_time), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS", "UTC") as event_time
| ((toMillis(now())-m_time)/(1000*60)) as since_mins | format("%.2f", since_mins) as since_minutes
| concat ("Since ", since_minutes, " minutes") as Remark
| where !(server_status = "Up")
| fields - m_time, since_mins, since_minutes 
| fields hostname, event_time, server_status, remark

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs COMMAND
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.command.$db","attr.durationMillis","attr.ns" as severity,timestamp,component,context,database,duration,namespace
| timeslice 1h
| avg(duration) by _timeslice, namespace
| transpose row _timeslice column namespace

panels.title: Number of CRUD Commands Over Time

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.command.$db","attr.durationMillis","attr.command","attr.ns" as severity,timestamp,component,context,database,duration,db_cmd,collection
| where component matches "*COMMAND*"
| parse regex field=db_cmd "(?<crud_operation>^[^:]*)"
| parse regex field=crud_operation "(?<crud_operation>(?<=\").*(?=\"))"
| where (crud_operation matches "*find*" or crud_operation matches "*insert*" or crud_operation matches "*remove*" or crud_operation matches "*delete*" or crud_operation matches "*update*" or crud_operation matches "*get*" or crud_operation matches "*aggregate*" or crud_operation matches "*replace*" or crud_operation matches "*save*" or crud_operation matches "*bulkWrite*")
| timeslice 1 h
| count by _timeslice, crud_operation
| transpose row _timeslice column crud_operation

children.name: MongoDB Atlas - Errors and Warnings
children.description: The MongoDB Atlas - Errors and Warnings dashboard provides information on errors, warnings, daily fatal warnings, errors and warnings by component, and fatal errors by component.
children.title: MongoDB Atlas - Errors and Warnings

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs (dbexit OR shutdown OR "shutting down")
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.exitCode" as severity,timestamp,component,context,code
| lookup desc  as error_description from https://s3.amazonaws.com/sumologic-app-data/mongo_exit_codes.csv on code=code
| count by timestamp, project_id, hostname, cluster_name, code, severity, msg, error_description, context, _sourceHost
| order by timestamp
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs ("socket exception" or exception or "SocketException")
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| count by timestamp,project_id,cluster_name,hostname,severity,component,context,msg, _sourceHost
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where severity in ("E", "F")
| count by component

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where severity in ("E", "F")
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where severity in ("W")
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where severity in ("W")
| count by component

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where severity in ("E", "F", "W")
| count by hostname, severity
| total _count by hostname
| transpose row hostname, _total column severity
| sort by _total

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where severity in ("E", "F")
| timeslice 1h
| count as today by _timeslice
| compare with timeshift 1d 7 avg
| today_7d_avg as last_week_avg
| fields -today_7d_avg

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where severity in ("E", "F")
| count by timestamp, project_id, hostname, cluster_name, severity, component, context , msg
| if (severity matches "F", 5, 4) as severity_order
| sort by severity_order, timestamp
| fields - _count , severity_order

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where severity in ("W", "I", "D")
| count by timestamp, project_id, cluster_name, hostname,severity, component, context , msg
| if (severity matches "W", 3, if(severity matches "I", 2, 1)) as severity_order
| sort by severity_order, timestamp
| fields - _count , severity_order

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs (Timeout or timeout) not ("SocketException")
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| count by timestamp,project_id, hostname, cluster_name, severity,component,context,msg
| fields - _count

children.name: MongoDB Atlas - Logins and Connections
children.description: The MongoDB Atlas - Logins and Connections dashboard provides a high-level view of the geographic locations of client connection requests, remote IP addresses of malicious logins, and the locations of failed logins.
children.title: MongoDB Atlas - Logins and Connections

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs ("connection accepted" and NETWORK) 
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx","attr.remote" as timestamp,severity,component,context,client_ip
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| parse regex field=client_ip "(?<client_ip>(?<=).*(?=:))"
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = client_ip
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")
| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users", "result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name
| timeslice 1h
| count by remote_ip
| lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence, threat from sumo://threat/cs on threat=remote_ip
| where type="ip_address" and malicious_confidence ="high"
| json field=raw "malware_families[*]" as threat_malware_families nodrop
| json field=raw "last_updated" as last_updated nodrop
| formatDate(fromseconds(last_updated), "MM-dd-yyyy") as threat_last_updated 
| json field=raw "labels[*].name" as label_name nodrop
| replace(label_name, "\\/","->") as label_name
| replace(label_name, "\""," ") as label_name
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = remote_ip

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs (NETWORK OR ASIO) (reach OR connect)
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx","attr.error.codeName","attr.error.errmsg" as timestamp,severity,component,context,errorName,errorMessage
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| where (component matches "*NETWORK*" or component matches "*ASIO*") and (errorName matches "*HostUnreachable*")
| hostname as from_node
| parse regex field=errorMessage "(?<dest_node>(?<=server ).*(?=,))" nodrop
| last(msg) by project_id, cluster_name, from_node, dest_node
| if (_last matches "Successfully*", 1, 0) as isreachable
| where isreachable = 0
| _last as message
| fields -isreachable,_last

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")
| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users", "result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name
| timeslice 1h
| count by remote_ip
| lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence, threat from sumo://threat/cs on threat=remote_ip
| where type="ip_address" and malicious_confidence ="high"
| json field=raw "malware_families[*]" as threat_malware_families nodrop
| json field=raw "last_updated" as last_updated nodrop
| formatDate(fromseconds(last_updated), "MM-dd-yyyy") as threat_last_updated 
| json field=raw "labels[*].name" as label_name nodrop
| replace(label_name, "\\/","->") as label_name
| replace(label_name, "\""," ") as label_name
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs "authentication failed"
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx","attr.authenticationDatabase","attr.remote","attr.principalName","attr.error" as timestamp,severity,component,context,database,client_ip,user,reason
| substring(client_ip,0,15) as client_ip
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| count by timestamp, project_id, hostname, cluster_name, user, database, client_ip, reason
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs "authentication failed"
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx","attr.authenticationDatabase","attr.remote","attr.principalName","attr.error" as timestamp,severity,component,context,database,client_ip,user,reason
| parse regex field=client_ip "(?<client_ip>(?<=).*(?=:))"
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name" 
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = client_ip
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort _count

panels.title: Threat Intel Outlier by Remote IP

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")| json "atype", "local.ip", "remote.ip", "users","result", "project_id", "hostname", "cluster_name" as atype, local_ip, remote_ip, users, result, project_id, hostname, cluster_name
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, remote_ip
| lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence, threat from sumo://threat/cs on threat=remote_ip
| where type="ip_address" and malicious_confidence ="high"
| json field=raw "malware_families[*]" as threat_malware_families nodrop
| json field=raw "last_updated" as last_updated nodrop
| formatDate(fromseconds(last_updated), "MM-dd-yyyy") as threat_last_updated 
| json field=raw "labels[*].name" as label_name nodrop
| replace(label_name, "\\/","->") as label_name
| replace(label_name, "\""," ") as label_name
| sum(_count) as count by _timeslice
| outlier count

children.name: MongoDB Atlas - Replication
children.description: The MongoDB Atlas - Replication dashboard provides information on changes in replication configurations.
children.title: MongoDB Atlas - Replication

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs REPL (error* OR fail* OR exception)
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where component matches "*REPL*"
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs REPL 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.primary" as severity,timestamp,component,context,primary_node
| withtime msg 
| most_recent(msg_withtime) as message by  hostname

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs REPL
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where severity = "W" and  component matches "*REPL*"
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs REPL (error* OR fail* OR exception)
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where component matches "*REPL*"
| count by timestamp, project_id, hostname, cluster_name, severity, component, context , msg
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and REPL and (! "Error in heartbeat" )  and !(	"Not starting an election, since we are not electable") and !("pings from other members before syncing")
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.hostAndPort" as severity,timestamp,component,context,host_name
| count by timestamp, project_id, cluster_name, hostname, severity, context , msg
| order by timestamp 
| limit 100
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs and REPL
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| count by timestamp, project_id, cluster_name, hostname, severity, context , msg
| order by timestamp 
| limit 100
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs *Heartbeat* *fail*
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx" as severity,timestamp,component,context
| where component matches "*REPL*"
| count by timestamp,project_id, cluster_name,hostname, severity,component,msg, _sourceHost
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs is in state
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.hostAndPort","attr.newState" as severity,timestamp,component,context,hostaddressport,state
| parse regex field=hostaddressport "(?<host_name>^.*(?=:))"
| where component matches "*REPL*" and state = "SECONDARY"
| withtime msg 
| most_recent(msg_withtime) as message by  host_name,state

children.name: MongoDB Atlas - Sharding
children.description: The MongoDB Atlas - Sharding dashboard provides information on cluster sharding. Panels show details on warnings, errors, chunk split failures, balancer failures, chunks moving by collection, and chunks moving between shards.
children.title: MongoDB Atlas - Sharding

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs SHARDING
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx" as timestamp,severity,component,context
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| where component matches "*SHARDING*" and severity = "W" 
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs SHARDING
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx" as timestamp,severity,component,context
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| where component matches "*SHARDING*" and severity in ("F","E") 
| count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs SHARDING 
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx" as timestamp,severity,component,context
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| where component matches "*SHARDING*" and severity = "W" 
| count as count, last(timestamp) as last_date by project_id, cluster_name, hostname, severity,component,context,msg, _sourceHost

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs SHARDING (error or fail or exception)
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx" as timestamp,severity,component,context
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| where component matches "*SHARDING*" 
| count as count, last(timestamp) as last_date by project_id, cluster_name, hostname, severity,component,context,msg, _sourceHost

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs SHARDING and (error* or fail* or exception*) BALANCER
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx" as timestamp,severity,component,context
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| where severity in  ("W", "E") and context matches "*Balancer*"
| count by timestamp,cluster_name,project_id,hostname,severity,component,context,msg, _sourceHost
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs *move* *Chunk*
| json field=_raw "attr.event.ns"
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx","attr.event.details.from","attr.event.details.to","attr.event.ns" as timestamp,severity,component,context,fromShard,toShard,collection
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| count by collection

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs moveChunk
| json field=_raw "attr.event.ns"
| json "t.$date","s","c","ctx","attr.event.details.from","attr.event.details.to","attr.event.ns" as timestamp,severity,component,context,fromShard,toShard,collection
| json "msg","project_id","hostname","cluster_name"
| _sourceHost as Host
| count by fromShard,toShard, Host

panels.title: Chunk Split by Shard and Collection

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs *split* *chunk* 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.splitPoint","attr.namespace","attr.shardId" as severity,timestamp,component,context,chunkSplitPoint,collection,shard
| count by chunkSplitPoint,shard,collection
| fields - _count

children.name: MongoDB Atlas  - Slow Queries
children.description: The MongoDB Atlas - Slow Queries dashboard provides details on the number of slow queries by type and their trends, connection IDs for slow queries, and slow server status.
children.title: MongoDB Atlas  - Slow Queries

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs "Slow query"
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.command.$db","attr.durationMillis" as severity,timestamp,component,context,database,duration
| number(duration)
| where duration > "{{duration}}"
| count by database
| order by _count desc
| limit 10

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs "Slow query"
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.command.$db","attr.durationMillis" as severity,timestamp,component,context,database,duration
| number(duration)
| where duration > "{{duration}}"
| count

panels.title: Slow CRUD Operations by Database and Collection

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.command.$db","attr.durationMillis","attr.command","attr.ns" as severity,timestamp,component,context,database,duration,db_cmd,collection
| where component matches "*COMMAND*"
| parse regex field=db_cmd "(?<crud_operation>^[^:]*)"
| parse regex field=crud_operation "(?<crud_operation>(?<=\").*(?=\"))"
| where (crud_operation matches "*find*" or crud_operation matches "*insert*" or crud_operation matches "*remove*" or crud_operation matches "*delete*" or crud_operation matches "*update*" or crud_operation matches "*get*" or crud_operation matches "*aggregate*" or crud_operation matches "*replace*" or crud_operation matches "*save*" or crud_operation matches "*bulkWrite*")

| parse regex field=users "(?<json_blob>\{[^\}]+\})" multi
| json auto field=json_blob
| json field=json_blob "user", "db" as user, database_name
| count by user, atype
| if (atype matches "*create*" OR atype matches "*add*" OR atype matches "*grant*", "created", if (atype matches "*drop*" OR atype matches "*remove*" OR atype matches "*revoke*", "deleted", if (atype matches "*update*", "updated", "other"))) as audit_action_type

| parse regex field=users "\"user\":\"(?<user>.*?)\"" multi nodrop
| parse field=namespace "*.*" as database, collection
| where atype matches "authCheck" and command matches /find|insert|delete|update|findandmodify/
| first(_messageTime) as latest_event_date group by atype, project_id, hostname, cluster_name, database, collection, user, command, local_ip, remote_ip

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs AND (_source="mongodb-audit-log.gz" OR _source="mongos-audit-log.gz")

| json field=param "db", "ns" as database1, database2 nodrop
| parse field=database2 "*.*" as database2, collection nodrop
| if (isBlank(database1), database2, database1) as database
| where atype matches /create|add|grant|drop|remove|revoke|shutdown|rename|update|authenticate|authcheck/
| first(_messageTime) as latest_event_date group by atype, project_id, hostname, cluster_name,  database, collection, users, local_ip, remote_ip
| sort by latest_event_date
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(latest_event_date)),"MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss:SSS") as latest_event_date

| json "id", "groupId", "orgId", "eventTypeName", "metricName", "links", "hostname", "port", "created", "username", "remoteAddress" as id, project_id, org_id, eventTypeName, metricName, links, hostname, port,created, username, remoteAddress nodrop
| where eventTypeName matches "*"
| if (isNull(org_id), format("https://cloud.mongodb.com/v2/%s#activity", project_id),format("https://cloud.mongodb.com/v2#/org/%s/activity/list", org_id)) as link
| tourl(link, id) as id
| count by created, id, org_id, project_id, eventTypeName, metricName, hostname, port, username, remoteAddress
| sort by created
